status: historical exploratory parser-retention comparison, not the final pinned-source benchmark

sourceProvenance.baseline: Only codex-rollout-file-parse.ts was loaded with git show from this commit; other bundled project dependencies came from the worktree.
sourceProvenance.current: Actual worktree parser and project dependencies at the time of the exploratory run.
sourceProvenance.limitation: Source hashes and individual heap snapshots were not saved during this run. Later hashes cannot establish the earlier source. Use the reproducible full-graph comparison for final evidence.

instrumentation.fixture: 100,000 event_msg/token_count rows with distinct one-second timestamps, model gpt-5-codex, last usage input 100/output 10/total 110, and one session_meta row; written in batches of 5,000.
instrumentation.metric: heapUsed after two forced full GCs before parse, every 35 ms during parse, and after parse
instrumentation.isolation: Each measurement had its own async function scope; result held on globalThis through the final sample, removed at function end, with setImmediate before the next baseline sample.
instrumentation.ownership: baseline claimEventKey and current canClaimEventKey accept queryIndex++ % stride === 0; current commitEventKey is a no-op
instrumentation.interpretation: Sampled retained memory, not absolute process peak. Timings are not a speed benchmark.
